name: Publishing & Discovery
description: Examples include catch-all repositories (e.g., Zenodo), data repositories (e.g., PANGAEA), software repositories, scientific data collections (e.g., Copernicus and biobanks), metadata aggregators and catalogues, scholarly knowledge graphs (SKGs), service catalogues, instrument registries, APIs, web portals, and semantic artefact catalogues (e.g., OntoPortal-based catalogues, EBI-based catalogues, and TIB Terminology Services).

name: Research Assessment & Monitoring
description: Examples include FAIR validators, Open Science monitoring tools, and research impact and evaluation systems.

name: Data Management & Curation
description: Examples include data management plan tools (DMP tools), metadata editors, curation and annotation platforms, and data policy management tools.

name: Data Processing & Analysis
description: Examples include Jupyter notebooks, workflow engines, analysis platforms, AI and machine-learning services, and statistical tools.

name: Compute Services
description: Examples include HPC clusters, cloud computing infrastructure (IaaS), virtual machines, and container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.

name: Storage Services
description: Examples include object storage such as S3, archival storage, file systems, backup services, long-term preservation platforms, and secure storage services.

name: Networking Services
description: Examples include research networks (NRENs), VPNs, high-speed data-transfer services, and federated connectivity services.

name: Science Gateways
description: Examples include web-based research platforms, virtual laboratories, and Virtual Research Environments (VREs).

name: Instrumentation & Physical Resources
description: Examples include laboratory instruments, sensors, IoT devices, and experimental facilities.

name: Research Support & Collaboration
description: Examples include user-support and consultancy services, collaboration platforms, and project-management tools.

name: Training & Skills Development
description: Examples include e-learning platforms, MOOCs, training portals, webinars, and certification services.

name: Infrastructure Operations Services
description: Examples include authentication and authorization infrastructures (AAI), federated identity systems such as eduGAIN, monitoring systems, and helpdesk platforms.

name: Persistent Identifiers
description: Examples include persistent identifier and registry services for researchers, organizations, and research resources, such as DOI, ORCID, and ROR.

name: Other
description: Use this category if and only if the service does not match any of the other classifications.
